=== D.SIM Synthetic longitudinal engine ===
 Five hypothetical trajectories with treatment events, clinical values and uncertainty. 
Sources: PRD,ARCH
  <-- HAS_DOMAIN ROOT CancerOS breast cancer digital twin
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.ELIG Treatment and scenario eligibility
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.RESPONSE Family 1: strong response
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.STABLE Family 2: partial/stable
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.PROGRESS Family 3: progression
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.REGROW Family 4: response then regrowth
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.TOXIC Family 5: clinical deterioration
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.EXPOSURE Treatment exposures
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.LATENT Latent evolution state
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.OBS Observation simulation
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.SEED Reproducibility
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.VALID Simulation validation
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.BATCH Cohort branching target

=== DATA.NOTE ClinicalNote ===
 Source text or synthetic note with context, negation and evidence spans. 
Sources: DATA,API
  <-- OWNS D.DATA Clinical research data
  <-- RELATES_TO DATA.VISIT ClinicalVisit

=== DATA.OUTCOME OutcomeObservation ===
 Recorded real endpoint or synthetic state; pCR distinct from MRI response. 
Sources: DATA,API
  <-- OWNS D.DATA Clinical research data
  <-- RELATES_TO DATA.PATIENT ResearchPatient

=== DATA.PROV ProvenanceRecord ===
 Real observed, real derived, synthetic generated, interpolated or model predicted with parent, version and hash. 
Sources: DATA,API
  <-- OWNS D.DATA Clinical research data
  <-- CONSTRAINS GOV.PROV Five provenance classes

=== IMG.SYNMESH Synthetic lesion geometry ===
 Transform baseline mask to target volume with validated geometry, label synthetic; no fabricated follow-up MRI. 
Sources: IMG,REF
  <-- IMPLEMENTS D.IMG Medical imaging
  <-- PRECEDES IMG.VOL Quantitative measurement
  <-- HAS_STEP WF.SIM Synthetic scenario vertical slice
  <-- WORKFLOW_PRECEDES SIM.OBS Observation simulation
  --> WORKFLOW_PRECEDES SIM.VALID Simulation validation
  <-- CONSTRAINS GOV.PROV Five provenance classes

=== AI.FORECAST Optional future-state forecasts ===
 Only with qualified independent real-data evaluation; abstain otherwise. Synthetic simulator is not predictive validation. 
Sources: AI,SAF
  <-- IMPLEMENTS D.AI Multimodal intelligence
  <-- CONSTRAINS GOV.ABSTAIN Disclose unknowns
  <-- VERIFIES EVAL.REAL Authentic longitudinal case evaluation

=== UX.3D Interactive lesion viewport ===
 Rotate, pan, zoom, reset; clearly distinguish observed/synthetic/illustrative geometry. 
Sources: PRD,UX
  <-- IMPLEMENTS D.UX Researcher experience
  <-- HAS_STEP WF.REAL Real imaging vertical slice
  <-- WORKFLOW_PRECEDES IMG.MESH Mask-to-mesh conversion
  --> WORKFLOW_PRECEDES EVAL.PHANTOM Geometry phantom tests

=== UX.EVAL Evaluation/limitations view ===
 What was tested, real versus synthetic metrics, cohort size, unknowns and known failures. 
Sources: PRD,UX
  <-- IMPLEMENTS D.UX Researcher experience

=== EVAL.E2E End-to-end demo ===
 One MRI → mask → measurable mesh → five synthetic scenarios → timeline → AI interpretation. 
Sources: TEST
  <-- TESTS D.EVAL Scientific evaluation
  <-- HAS_STEP WF.RELEASE Demo readiness
  --> WORKFLOW_PRECEDES EVAL.AI NLP/LLM grounding evaluation
  --> VERIFIES WF.REAL Real imaging vertical slice
  --> VERIFIES WF.SIM Synthetic scenario vertical slice

=== EVAL.REPORT Scientific limitations report ===
 Cohort size, methods, source licenses, real/synthetic distinction and unvalidated claims. 
Sources: TEST

  <-- WORKFLOW_PRECEDES EVAL.REAL Authentic longitudinal case evaluation

DAT.02 — Licensing and provenance
Design: Separate source licensing, original/derived/synthetic origin and immutable lineage
Acceptance: Provenance complete; unauthorized sources quarantined
  READ A14 TRIPOD-LLM — Model/data/evaluation reporting checklist; consult full checklist and elaboration — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12104976/
  REPO R07 IDC Index — reproducible dataset collection and download — https://github.com/ImagingDataCommons/idc-index
  PAPER P05 Breast MRI clinical trial image collections —  — https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/ispy2/

DAT.03 — Data quality and missingness
Design: Do not impute absent labs or tumor labels without explicit derived/synthetic markers
Acceptance: Missingness and unit validation fixtures
  READ A11 Longitudinal Data Analysis — Wiley — Mixed-effects models, repeated-measure correlation and missing longitudinal observations; confirm edition-specific chapter titles — https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/book/10.1002/0470036486
